reason: The battery fixes the power cut, but in our house the bigger problem is water. Half the time the tank is not full when the light comes back, so a ₹22,000 machine still ends up waiting while we wash by hand.
objection: Water supply is not reliable, so a machine that finishes the load without power does not help much if there is no water to fill it. And nobody I know has used this battery type, so I don't know if it will last three years in our heat.
would_change_my_mind: If a relative or neighbour in the block had one running for a few months and said it really works with our water and power, and the dealer showed me it can run on stored bucket water.
